title: B. One winner passes, room 60%, room 100% from session 6 (clock press)
question: Owner order 2026-10-18: an MFFU 50K eval must be passed within 10 sessions; maximise P(pass in 10) and minimise $91.80 / P(pass in 10).
verdict: Clock press: careful (60% of the room) for 5 sessions, then all of it. Between A and C. 50K: H1 starts (pick) pass/fail/open within 10 sessions 54.6/14.3/31.1% (n 119), within 20 74.3/20.2%, cost per 2-week pass $168.0, worst day $-1,008, max at risk $987; H2 starts (check) pass/fail/open within 10 sessions 52.2/13.0/34.8% (n 69), within 20 55.9/33.9%, cost per 2-week pass $176.0, worst day $-1,007, max at risk $992; 2026 pass/fail/open within 10 sessions 51.3/15.7/33.0% (n 197), within 20 61.5/31.0%, cost per 2-week pass $179.0, worst day $-1,008, max at risk $992; Monte Carlo 4,000 x 20 sessions (5-session blocks): H1 52.6/16.3/31.1, H2 57.5/17.9/24.6; 2021-25 reference (5m) 18.3/24.6. Back to back (new eval after a pass, a fail or 10 sessions): 2026 15 passes in 31 evals ($190 a pass), 2021-25 24 in 127 ($486). 25K ($63, every $ halved): H1 54.6/16.0, H2 56.5/21.7, cost per 2-week pass H1 $115.0 / H2 $112.0.
